tei:div.tei:p: This prayer was first published as a PDF on Moked, “Italy’s Jewish portal” linked from “Coronavirus, i rabbini italiani “Le nostre preghiere per chi soffre”” (2020-02-26). The English translation of the prayer in Hebrew and Italian was made from the Italian by Aharon Varady. English Translations of Pitum haketoret, Psalms 100 and Psalms 150 were added from Varady’s Siddur Livnat haSapir and the Open Siddur. Many thanks to Isaac Gantwerk Mayer for providing the lacking Italian translation of Psalms 100, 150, Pitum haKetoret, Deuteronomy 6:4, and Ana Hashem — all copied from the Siddur of Samuel David Luzzato (ShaDaL 1866, with gratitude to Enrico Segre for uploading a “>scan of the siddur to the Internet Archive).
